title: Reverse an array-backed list
description: Implement reverse_links(nodes, head). Nodes are [value, next_index], with -1 for null. Reverse the reachable links in place and return the new head. Unreachable nodes must be unchanged. The list is acyclic with valid pointers.
hints: Save the next pointer before overwriting it.
setup:
def reverse_check(nodes, head):
    return [reverse_links(nodes, head), nodes]
